name: Stepford County Railway 🚉
desc:
Welcome to Stepford County Railway! A train network simulation game with driving, dispatching, guarding and signalling.

Join the group and attend training sessions to unlock more roles in-game.
You can access all roles by joining a Private Server.

== Common Issues ==
> If you find yourself lagging when looking into the distance, check Roblox graphics settings. Try level 8 or 9 instead of 10 if using manual mode, or try automatic mode.
